title: Banana
body:
"Bananas are elongated, yellow fruit with a soft, creamy texture."

Description

The Banana is a item that can be found on King Palm trees. Can spawn in bunches ranging from 15-30.

It may be sold to Jer Junkman for $50 per Banana. In its jam form it may be sold for $200.

Increases jump height to when eaten, to about the same height as with a Gravity Coil or Fusion Coil. (Does not stack with the coils)

When put into a Composter, the fill level increases by ~1.75% per banana.
